name: Magus Martial Alchemist
body:
Martial Alchemy

Prepares extracts instead of typical spells. Adds touch attack spells to formulae list as extracts (1st—chill touch, shocking grasp; 2nd—flame blade, ghoul touch, touch of idiocy; 3rd—poison, vampiric touch; 4th—calcific touch, rusting grasp, spite). Replaces cantrips and alters spellcasting.

Alchemical Discovery (Ex)

At 4th level, gains one alchemist discovery (no mutagen requirements) using magus level as alchemist level. Replaces spell recall.

Martial Alchemist Arcana

Quick Draught (drink potions or apply oils without AoO), Poison Resistance (+2 save vs. poison, stackable up to immunity), Poison Use (never accidentally poison self), Swift Poisoning (apply poison as a swift action).
